title: data/balance.json ships a dead default_budget field — relic of the removed budget system
evidence:
"default_budget": 5200,

Verified dead: `grep -rn 'default_budget' core/ app/ harness/` returns NO code references, and the Balance struct in core/catalog.odin has no default_budget field (starting_links/starting_routers/grants fully replace it). The field is parsed as JSON and silently ignored.
detail: Orphaned by the budget->hardware-inventory user ruling. The catalog (stated single source of truth) carries a number that looks load-bearing but does nothing, inviting wasted balance tuning.
recommended_fix: Delete the `"default_budget": 5200,` line from data/balance.json; the inventory's starting_inventory + grants fully replace it.
